sql:
SELECT s.District, AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District, AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District, AVG(f.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT dname
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY dname
ORDER BY AVG(AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.District, AVG(s.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode AND s.sname = sch.School AND s.dname = sch.District
WHERE sch.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY d.District
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District, AVG(sc.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = REPLACE(sc.cds, ' ', '')
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.District Name
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE frpm.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY frpm.District Name
ORDER BY AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.District Name
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE frpm.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY frpm.District Name
ORDER BY AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District, AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(sa.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District 
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(sa.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.District AS Active_District,
    AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS Average_Score_Reading
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY 
    s.District
ORDER BY 
    Average_Score_Reading DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District AS ActiveDistrict, AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds AND ss.rtype = 'D'
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.District,
    AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY 
    s.District
ORDER BY 
    AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District 
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(f.FRPM Count (K-12)) DESC
LIMIT 1;
